opportunities.title: Senior clinical pharmacist in a primary care network, focused on older people and care homes
opportunities.why_you: Your five years in Care of the Elderly and your medicines reconciliation skill suit complex polypharmacy reviews. You would also keep making the escalation calls you want to hold on to.
opportunities.skill_to_add: General practice clinic and caseload management

opportunities.title: Clinical safety officer for digital health systems
opportunities.why_you: Your rapid clinical risk judgement and your work on medicines safety incident reviews are the core of clinical risk management for software. As a pharmacist you are a registered clinician, which the role requires.
opportunities.skill_to_add: Digital clinical risk standards (DCB0129 and DCB0160)
opportunities.source_title: Clinical Safety Officer (CSO) services for the NHS

opportunities.title: Sessional pharmacist teacher of prescribing for medical students
opportunities.why_you: You already teach new junior doctors every four months and have a practised way of bringing newcomers up to speed. A medical school could use that, alongside your ward post.
opportunities.source_title: Pharmacist Peer-Led Teaching Enhances Medical Undergraduate Prescribing: A Mixed-Methods Study

opportunities.title: Pharmacist-led deprescribing in care homes
opportunities.why_you: Your understanding of polypharmacy and frailty, plus your experience persuading doctors without authority over them, is what deprescribing in care homes depends on. It also gives you variety and clear patient impact.
opportunities.skill_to_add: Structured deprescribing for frail older people
opportunities.source_title: Enhancing deprescribing: A qualitative understanding of the complexities of pharmacist-led deprescribing in care homes

opportunities.title: Medicines safety reviewer for AI tools in pharmacy
opportunities.why_you: Because you would hand reconciliation to AI, your rapid risk judgement and incident review experience are what is needed to spot where such tools fail. You would also teach colleagues to use them safely.
opportunities.source_title: FIP STATEMENT OF POLICY Artificial intelligence in pharmacy practice

opportunities.title: Split week: acute hospital pharmacy plus advanced practice in general practice
opportunities.why_you: Your acute risk judgement and your teaching would transfer to general practice, while the hospital sessions keep your acute skills current. The mix gives you the variety and learning you value.
opportunities.source_title: Role of advanced practice pharmacists in general practice
